source_excerpts.text: Third-year PhD student has a 3-month direction deadline; advisor retires in 2-3 years; lab lacks single-cell experience or collaborators.
Current answer sequences advisor first, Silva second, committee third, and treats data access as the binding constraint.
Pressure check says the retiring advisor is not neutral and option 1 may stop being a real fallback after enough option-3 work.
Audit flags undefined base-rate reference class, incomplete option expansion, and under-specified constraint retesting.

artifacts.why_provided: The pressure check says the 18-month pivot may be fake if option 1 is no longer executable by then.
artifacts.source_grounding: Advisor retires in 2-3 years; option 1 depends on advisor support and lab continuity; pressure check says option 1 may close after option-3 work.
artifacts.contribution: Treat fallback viability as a hard boundary on any reversal-trigger plan.
artifacts.hard_boundary: Do not recommend an 18-month pivot unless the fallback target is still executable when the trigger fires.
artifacts.relaxation_condition: Advisor explicitly preserves an option-1 or modified-option-1 path, funding, and supervision through the trigger date.
artifacts.discard_condition: Discard only if the answer no longer uses option 1 as a fallback or reversal target.
artifacts.risk_if_forced: The answer may become too conservative and kill option 3 prematurely.
artifacts.risk_if_ignored: The user may rely on a fallback that quietly disappeared.

artifacts.why_provided: The answer names Dr. Silva/data access as bottleneck but needs a constraint-shift cadence after probes.
artifacts.source_grounding: Lab has no single-cell experience or collaborators; option 3 needs external data or collaboration; audit flags missing constraint retesting.
artifacts.contribution: Make the Silva probe a measured constraint test, not a one-off availability question.
artifacts.hard_boundary: Do not treat option 3 as viable until data access, sharing terms, and collaborator role can carry a dissertation.
artifacts.relaxation_condition: Silva or another collaborator offers usable data, clear sharing terms, and a role strong enough to reduce dissertation risk.
artifacts.discard_condition: Discard if the recommended option does not depend on external single-cell data access.
artifacts.risk_if_forced: The answer may over-process collaboration before advisor permission.
artifacts.risk_if_ignored: The user may commit politically before the binding constraint is tractable.

artifacts.why_provided: The current answer names a broad success rate without defining or testing the reference class.
artifacts.source_grounding: Audit flags base-rates as partially treated: the prior is named but not tied to aggregate data, fit criteria, or case-specific updating.
artifacts.contribution: Keep base rates as a humility check, not a calibrated probability claim.
artifacts.hard_boundary: Do not let a broad success-rate number size commitment unless the reference class matches this dissertation situation.
artifacts.relaxation_condition: Relevant cohort evidence appears for similar dissertations under comparable advisor, lab, and collaboration constraints.
artifacts.discard_condition: Discard if the answer avoids numeric success priors and uses only qualitative uncertainty.
artifacts.risk_if_forced: The answer may become pseudo-quantitative and distract from next actions.
artifacts.risk_if_ignored: The answer may overstate confidence without an outside-view check.

artifacts.why_provided: The audit flags incomplete option expansion, but the current answer already warns against parallel prototyping.
artifacts.source_grounding: Audit says option expansion is incomplete; current answer says prototyping all options is the failure-mode version of optionality.
artifacts.contribution: Use option expansion to widen evidence search, not to add new active dissertation tracks.
artifacts.hard_boundary: Do not turn option expansion into try-everything drift or a new delay tactic.
artifacts.relaxation_condition: A fourth option appears that uses lab infrastructure and reduces external dependency without losing career upside.
artifacts.discard_condition: Discard if the answer widens the evidence search without adding a new commitment path.
artifacts.risk_if_forced: The answer may become sprawling and weaken commitment cadence.
artifacts.risk_if_ignored: The answer may inherit the user's three-option frame too passively.

worker_admission.reason: The raw artifacts expose the two controlling gates and two quiet checks without requiring fresh worker cognition.
unnecessary_if: Step 6 can directly read fallback viability and Silva/data access as boundaries.
The base-rate and option-expansion artifacts are quiet checks rather than new cognition needs.
admit_only_if: A future fixture shows unresolved conflict that Step 6 cannot preserve from raw artifacts alone.

notes: Research-only compact fixture for testing raw artifact consumption before any bundle or worker implementation.
